results.question: I need to know when my stuff will arrive
results.answer:
Welcome to Amaze-on, where your satisfaction is our absolute top priority! 

Regarding when your items will arrive, the estimated delivery times depend on the shipping method selected after dispatch [c-d5800f31a5026138]:
* **Standard delivery:** Takes 3–5 business days after dispatch [c-d5800f31a5026138].
* **Express delivery:** Takes 1–2 business days after dispatch [c-d5800f31a5026138].

Please note that these are estimates rather than guarantees [c-d5800f31a5026138]. Furthermore, if your order includes a personalized product like a NameTag, there is an additional production time of 3 business days before dispatch, and express shipping speeds up transit rather than production time [c-d5800f31a5026138]. 

As for exact arrival dates and tracking, the assistant does not have access to dispatch information, a holiday calendar, or tracking details to provide a specific arrival date [c-d5800f31a5026138].
